blurb: Bad Dog Brewing Company is a craft microbrewery located in rural Sooke, British Columbia. Guests can visit the brewery to try their brews in pints, sleeves, single tall cans, 4 packs, growler fills, and tasting flights. The brewery has 12 taps and offers brewery tours and samples during open hours, along with nonalcoholic drinks, wine, cider, premixed gin/vodka, packaged snacks, and branded merchandise.
